object.name: evi.zitaverb~
object.digest: True stereo FDN/algorithmic reverb based on 'zitaverb' by Fons Adriaensen
object.description: A famous open source reverb algorithm with excellent room realness. GPL v2. The evieve version increases the available RT60 times for special effects, and smooths all parameters, as well as improving the internal filtering.
object.discussion: Zitaverb's character is more 'hall' than 'plate', but it can be used on a wide variety of instruments or voices. It is not a spatialiser - the early reflections are different for the L and R inputs, but do not correspond to any real room. They have been tuned to match left and right sources to some extent. For more information about other reverbs in evieve, see the 'evieve reverb' tab of the helpfile.

attributes.name: bypass
attributes.description: Smooth bypass the reverb (1). Bypassing also CPU-mutes the internal DSP.

attributes.name: crossover
attributes.description: The crossover frequency in Hz between the range of the 'lowdecay' and 'middecay' RT60 times. By tuning the RT60 times precisely this crossover control can have a big effect on the tonal balance of the reverb.

attributes.name: damp
attributes.description: The lowpass damping effect on the FDN is set to take effect at this frequency. Lower values result in a darker reverb.

attributes.name: drywet
attributes.description: Dry/Wet mix of direct signal and reverberated signal. Dry is 0, completely wet is 1.

attributes.name: eq1cutoff
attributes.description: The frequncey on Hz of the first twopole EQ filter.

attributes.name: eq1gain
attributes.description: The gain in dB of the first twopole EQ filter.

attributes.name: eq1type
attributes.description: Sets the filter type of the first EQ filter between Lowshelf (0), and Bell (1). The filters in evi.zitaverb~ are high quality TPT SVF linear filters and can be modulated in realtime.

attributes.name: eq2cutoff
attributes.description: The frequncey on Hz of the second twopole EQ filter.

attributes.name: eq2gain
attributes.description: The gain in dB of the second twopole EQ filter.

attributes.name: eq2type
attributes.description: Sets the filter type of the second EQ filter between Highshelf (0), and Bell (1). The filters in evi.zitaverb~ are high quality TPT SVF linear filters and can be modulated in realtime.

attributes.name: lowdecay
attributes.description: The low frequencies RT60 time set in seconds. Low values give a more realistic room sound, higher values produce atypical sustain effects verging on foreversustain but on specifically low frequency content.

attributes.name: middecay
attributes.description: The mid frequencies RT60 time set in seconds. Low values give a more realistic room sound, higher values produce atypical sustain effects verging on foreversustain but on specifically mid frequency content.

attributes.name: predelay
attributes.description: The pre delay time in ms applied to the dry input before the early reflections.
